title: What to expect during construction in your neighborhood

paragraphs: Construction hours, noise, street parking, and other info.

sections.heading: Hours
paragraphs: Building construction can occur 7:00 am to 8:00 pm seven days a week, including holidays.

sections.heading: Noise
paragraphs: Noise is expected during daytime construction, but cannot exceed five decibels above ambient at the nearest lot line before 7 am or after 8 pm. Five decibels is similar to the sound of a screw gun installing screws in drywall.

sections.heading: Noise › Some construction is allowed at night
paragraphs: Only construction projects with a night noise permit can do outdoor construction outside before 7 am or after 8 pm. This occurs for public safety, building structural integrity, or traffic and road access issues.
See current issued night noise permits .

sections.heading: Noise › Filing a complaint
paragraphs: You can call the Department of Building Inspection, Inspection Services at 628-652-3400 to report potential noise violations.
For construction beyond the allowed hours, you can call the SF Police Department's non-emergency line at 415-553-0123 during construction.
You can also file noise complaints with SF311 .

sections.heading: Street parking
paragraphs: Construction projects often require the use of street parking for trucks or construction debris boxes.
Street Space Permits are issued by the Department of Public Works. For more information, call 628-271-2000 .

sections.heading: Illegal construction
paragraphs: If you suspect illegal construction or work without permits, you can file a complaint and we will investigate. You will need to provide the property address and the type of work being done.

sections.heading: Illegal construction › By phone
paragraphs: During normal business hours, call Inspection Services at 628-652-3400 .
Outside of normal business hours, call 311 .

sections.heading: Find your local district inspector
paragraphs: District inspectors are assigned to geographic areas in San Francisco. They help ensure that construction is code-complaint and built according to the approved plans.
